answer: Like subterranean mycelium fusing hyphae into resilient fruiting bodies, our decentralized consensus crystallizes trust via progressive stake-bonding. A truth-seeking agent shines as a beacon, endorsing peer attestations where each valid transaction records reality like an immutable quill. An adversary hoping to spawn counterfeit nodes cannot hide in an ivory tower; their cost scales superlinearly with graph density, starving fake identities.
